THE DE LA RAMA STEAMSHIP CO., INC. M.S. DONA NATI December 22, 1943 PACIFIC WAR FRONT: General Marshall is making his first tour of the Southwest Pacific area and conferred with General MacArthur yesterday. No details were given of their conference. On New Britain the fighting at Arave was confined to extensive patrol activities. Our air force hit Cape Gloucester again with 139 tons of bombs and in sharp encounters in the New Britain area damaged seven Japanese merchant ships and destroyed forty Japanese planes. We lost six of ours. Bougainville was hit with 100 tons of bombs as Major-General Griswold is placed in command of the combined operations against this last enemy stronghold in the Solomons. In an attack in the Marshall Islands twenty one Japanese planes attempting to intercept the raiders were shot down with a loss of three to out side. EUROPEAN WAR FRONT: The important chemical and armament center of Frankfurt was devastated with 2000 tons of bombs and reconnaissance photographs show huge repair shops and railway equipment still on fire. Forty two planes were lost on this and other diversionary raids over Germany. British Air Marshall Harris warned the German people last night that their countries will be devastated from end to end until unconditional surrender. He estimated a 30% reduction in German production as a result of allied bombing. In Sofia B-24 Liberators again hit Sofia, capital of Bulgaria and a key railway junction point in Hitler's attempt to reinforce the Balkans. Also hit was a German airfield near Athens. Forty eight German planes were shot down. In Russia the winter drive continued west of Nevel taking 100 more towns and killing 1600 German troops. The last German bridgehead east of the Dnieper was wiped out and 2000 Germans killed. A number of Slovak troops attached to German divisions in the Ukraine came over to join the Czech army attached to the Russian forces. Patriot forces in Yugoslavia continued harassing the Nazis with the aid of large allied stores shipped to them from Italy. In their first long range attack since the consolidation of allied air forces in the Burma-India area a heavy raid was carried out in Bangkok in Thailand leaving huge fires in the dock areas. Other raids were carried in the southern Burma. THE END
